exposure: classification of cesarean section (elective or emergency)
cohort: A purposive sample of 160 women undergoing cesarean sections.
finding: The majority of women (63.8%) undergoing cesarean sections experienced moderate levels of preoperative anxiety, which was significantly associated with family income, previous miscarriages, pregnancy complications, and the classification of the cesarean section.
mod_finding: Preoperative anxiety levels were significantly associated with the classification of the cesarean section (elective or emergency).
